title: High school world
content: So last night I found myself in this familiar high school like building i've dreamed about before. lots of corridors, hallways, classrooms, random people walking to and from wherever, and a central area with a couple sets of stairs leading up to the second floor. it's a lot like the actual high school I went to before they renovated it. There was a reception desk area and I realized I was in this strange world again so I asked the lady behind the desk some question like if this was near mall world or something. I don't remember exactly what I asked. She started laughing like it was the most ridiculous thing she'd ever heard. I left her and then I felt myself coming out of it and I wasn't able to stay in it, and I woke up at that point.
